answer: A Registered domain bound by signed confirmation letter with annual re-verification turns a private channel into public evidence: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the signed confirmation letter is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a opal only after its channel answers the challenge. The signal test catches the lazy fake and the jade test catches the patient one.
